name: kitchen_rules_evaluation
description: Frozen closed-set kitchen hazard ruleset for the dissertation evaluation. Every rule is executable using only YOLO object classes, confidences, bounding boxes, image dimensions and sampled-frame evidence available in scene.json.

notes: No rule assumes appliance power state, heat, flame, liquid contents, user intention or hidden conditions.
Surface-edge rules require a detected supporting dining-table/work-surface box; the image boundary is never used as a substitute.
The ruleset is intentionally fixed and closed-set so that it can serve as a transparent baseline against the open-set VLM system.

rules.name: Knife close to work-surface edge
rules.description: A detected knife is close to the edge of its supporting work surface.
rules.explanation: The knife could be knocked or fall from the work surface.
rules.older_adult_relevance: Reduced peripheral vision or reaction speed may make a falling sharp object harder to avoid.
rules.recommended_action: Place the knife flat and farther from the work-surface edge.

rules.name: Scissors close to work-surface edge
rules.description: Detected scissors are close to the edge of their supporting work surface.
rules.explanation: The scissors could be knocked off and create a cutting or puncture risk.
rules.older_adult_relevance: Reduced peripheral vision or reaction speed may make a falling sharp object harder to avoid.
rules.recommended_action: Place the scissors closed and farther from the work-surface edge.

rules.name: Fork close to work-surface edge
rules.description: A detected fork is close to the edge of its supporting work surface.
rules.explanation: The fork could fall or be knocked from the surface.
rules.older_adult_relevance: A small falling utensil may be harder to notice or avoid with reduced vision or mobility.
rules.recommended_action: Move the fork inward and leave it flat on the work surface.

rules.name: Bottle close to work-surface edge
rules.description: A detected bottle is close to the edge of its supporting work surface.
rules.explanation: The bottle could fall, break or spill if it is knocked.
rules.older_adult_relevance: A fallen container may create clutter or a slipping risk that is harder to recover from.
rules.recommended_action: Move the bottle farther inward onto a stable part of the surface.

rules.name: Cup or glass close to work-surface edge
rules.description: A detected cup or glass is close to the edge of its supporting work surface.
rules.explanation: The container could be knocked over or fall from the surface.
rules.older_adult_relevance: Spilled liquid or broken glass may create a slipping or cutting hazard.
rules.recommended_action: Move the cup or glass farther from the work-surface edge.

rules.name: Bowl close to work-surface edge
rules.description: A detected bowl is close to the edge of its supporting work surface.
rules.explanation: The bowl could be knocked over or fall from the surface.
rules.older_adult_relevance: Spilled food or a fallen bowl may create clutter and require sudden movement.
rules.recommended_action: Move the bowl farther inward onto the work surface.

rules.name: Knife overlapping sink area
rules.description: A detected knife overlaps the visible sink area.
rules.explanation: A knife in the sink area may be obscured during washing or handling.
rules.older_adult_relevance: Reduced vision or touch sensitivity may make a partly concealed blade harder to notice.
rules.recommended_action: Remove the knife carefully and wash or store it separately.

rules.name: Scissors overlapping sink area
rules.description: Detected scissors overlap the visible sink area.
rules.explanation: Scissors in the sink area may be obscured among dishes or water.
rules.older_adult_relevance: Reduced visual contrast sensitivity or hand control may increase accidental contact risk.
rules.recommended_action: Remove the scissors and store them closed in a clearly visible place.

rules.name: Sharp tool close to drink container
rules.description: A sharp tool is very close to a frequently handled drink container.
rules.explanation: Reaching for the container may cause accidental contact with the nearby sharp tool.
rules.older_adult_relevance: Reduced hand coordination or visual awareness may increase accidental contact.
rules.recommended_action: Separate sharp tools from cups, glasses and bottles.

rules.name: Sharp tool close to bowl
rules.description: A sharp tool is very close to a detected bowl.
rules.explanation: Moving or reaching for the bowl may cause accidental contact with the sharp tool.
rules.older_adult_relevance: Reduced hand coordination or visual awareness may increase accidental contact.
rules.recommended_action: Move knives and scissors away from frequently handled bowls.

rules.name: Metal utensil overlapping microwave
rules.description: A detected metal utensil overlaps the visible microwave area.
rules.explanation: The utensil may be inside or immediately against the microwave opening.
rules.older_adult_relevance: A confusing appliance setup may increase the chance of unsafe microwave use.
rules.recommended_action: Check and remove metal utensils before operating the microwave.

rules.name: Metal utensil overlapping toaster
rules.description: A detected metal utensil overlaps the visible toaster area.
rules.explanation: The utensil may be touching or entering the toaster area.
rules.older_adult_relevance: Reduced dexterity may increase the chance of unsafe contact around a toaster.
rules.recommended_action: Do not insert metal utensils into a toaster; disconnect it before safe removal.

rules.name: Bottle very close to oven or toaster
rules.description: A detected bottle is very close to an oven or toaster.
rules.explanation: The bottle may be knocked, heated or spilled while the nearby appliance is used.
rules.older_adult_relevance: Reduced grip strength or reaction speed may make a spill or hot container harder to manage.
rules.recommended_action: Move the bottle to a stable area away from the appliance.

rules.name: Person very close to knife
rules.description: A detected person is very close to a detected knife.
rules.explanation: Close interaction with a knife may create a cutting risk.
rules.older_adult_relevance: Reduced dexterity, grip stability or reaction speed may increase injury risk.
rules.recommended_action: Keep fingers clear of the blade and use a stable cutting surface.

rules.name: Person very close to scissors
rules.description: A detected person is very close to detected scissors.
rules.explanation: Close interaction with scissors may create a cutting or puncture risk.
rules.older_adult_relevance: Reduced dexterity or slower hand control may increase injury risk.
rules.recommended_action: Handle scissors carefully and keep them closed when not in use.
